name: Worldpay Card Verifications API
description:
Determine the validity of your customer's card to maximize authorization rates.

Authentication header Authorization: {yourcredentials} Replace {yourcredentials} with your base64-encoded Basic Auth username and password given to your by your Worldpay Implementation Manager.

You must use the Authorization header for any request you send to our Card Verifications API.

Accept/Content-Type header for card verifications Content-Type : application/vnd.world
